target.goal: Strengthen the HELIOS maintained combination using mechanisms already developed elsewhere in the Hawkar-usls/JANUS portfolio, while preserving provenance, authority boundaries and prior-art honesty.

anti_pattern: DO_NOT_IMPORT_FEATURES_ONLY_BECAUSE_THEY_EXIST; TRANSPLANT A MECHANISM ONLY WHEN ITS AUTHORITY_AND_EVIDENCE_SEMANTICS_SURVIVE_THE_MOVE

name_resolution_notes.note: The organism is a federated manifest, not a separate repository under that exact name.
The inspected Hrain NEXUS link declares local reference semantics and no live cross-repository transport.
No public repository resolved under that exact name during this sweep; no replacement was guessed.

already_transplanted.source_mechanism: Adaptive thermal contraction: temperature/stability pressure contracts load rather than forcing the machine to tolerate a fixed load.
already_transplanted.important_transformation: The old experimental human-observation surfaces were deliberately removed. HELIOS keeps hardware telemetry and makes the guardian HUMAN_BLIND.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: Build a privacy-preserving Device Health Passport from a chain of measured hardware observations, with facts, deterministic derived metrics and claims separated; unknown remains unknown; integrity does not masquerade as sensor truth.
ranked_candidates.why_helios_needs_it: Turns device-care from a policy promise into auditable history suitable for contributors, compute providers and enterprise buyers.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: Bind a receipt to exact source/executor/verifier/workflow/artifact identities instead of treating PASS text as authority.
ranked_candidates.helios_translation: Every authoritative HELIOS receipt should bind provider manifest/version, adapter digest, exact executor artifact digest, verifier identity/digest, Desktop Agent/Fabric versions, Guardian policy digest, lease/job IDs and provider settlement evidence.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: Unknown providers and ambient text/model output receive no execution authority. Provider capabilities are explicitly scoped, revocable, budgeted and epoch-bound; epoch rotation invalidates stale authority.
ranked_candidates.helios_translation: Provider admission default DENY; create Provider Authority Epoch. Provider manifests/adapters/verifiers receive non-transferable scoped capability leases. Reconnect or policy rotation cannot resurrect stale provider authority.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: Primary mission and protected local reserves outrank optional side work; shed optional work first under resource pressure.
ranked_candidates.helios_translation: External provider compute is always a bounded side mission. Hardware Guardian plus host-pressure telemetry reduce/suspend provider work before local safety/user reserves are violated, without needing screen/process surveillance.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: Lease ID is a fencing token; replacement ownership cannot be deleted/released by stale holders; durable recovery resumes only under exact source/lease/state pins and otherwise fails closed.
ranked_candidates.helios_translation: Resume-safe provider jobs across crash/reconnect. Persist exact provider/task/artifact/lease/Guardian policy pins; stale results and stale release attempts cannot mutate replacement work.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: Fast path is promoted only after reference comparison and benchmarking; periodic cross-checks can demote it and restore fallback.
ranked_candidates.helios_translation: CUDA/ROCm/vendor-optimized executors enter SHADOW, are compared against a reference executor/verifier, then become QUALIFIED only after bounded equivalence tests. Periodic canaries can revoke qualification.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: A successor verifier may not silently forget inherited mandatory rejections; intentional weakening requires replayable evidence and explicit versioned semantics.
ranked_candidates.helios_translation: Provider adapter/verifier upgrades cannot silently weaken old safety, artifact, signature or settlement gates. Removed gates require an explicit migration proof and new semantics identity.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: Verify serialized evidence with an independent checker that deliberately does not call the producer's own verifier, and require corrupted negative controls to fail.
ranked_candidates.helios_translation: A provider adapter is not production-qualified merely because its own verifier says PASS. Qualification includes independent replay plus corrupt-receipt/artifact/signature/lease negative controls.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: Do not use a convenient state count as total work; explicitly count calls, hits, edges, terminals and attempts that actually consumed effort.
ranked_candidates.helios_translation: Do not equate assigned work, accepted jobs or nominal runtime with completed useful compute. Track admitted slices, executed slices, retries, rejected/stale results, verified results, actual device-hours and measured watt-hours separately.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: Repository/method memory may route investigation but may not promote itself into truth; negative results, failures and research debt stay searchable.
ranked_candidates.helios_translation: For every provider adapter maintain capability, unsupported-class, verifier-strength, settlement-authority, known-failure and next-gate records. A provider marketing claim or adapter registration is routing metadata, not proof of capability.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: Represent nodes with explicit evidence/authority state and typed relationships; structural linkage does not create truth or authority.
ranked_candidates.helios_translation: Build an inspectable Compute Lineage Graph linking user consent policy -> provider manifest -> lease -> Guardian decision -> executor artifact -> work result -> verifier -> settlement receipt -> Device Health Passport, with explicit states such as OBSERVED/VERIFIED/UNKNOWN/REVOKED.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: Give the exact same frozen package to independent reviewers, preserve disagreement and fail closed instead of averaging incompatible conclusions.
ranked_candidates.helios_translation: Ordinary jobs may use one authoritative provider verifier, but high-value/scientific/contested work can require multiple independent verifier identities. Disagreement -> HOLD/NON_AUTHORITATIVE, never majority-washed truth.

ranked_candidates.mechanism: Source count is not independent-root count; more reviewers/capabilities do not manufacture authority; disagreement and HOLD are first-class outputs.
ranked_candidates.helios_translation: Provider reputation should count independent verifier/settlement/failure domains rather than raw number of receipts or endpoints. Multiple adapters backed by the same authority source do not count as independent confirmation.

implementation_order.reason: These four directly strengthen the first real provider pilot and make HELIOS device-sovereign, provider-fail-closed and auditable.
These turn a successful pilot into an enterprise-grade transferable execution system.
Useful when HELIOS routes high-value, scientific or multi-provider workloads; not a blocker for the first pilot.

emergent_moat_after_internal_sweep.statement: HELIOS should not compete by claiming that gaming plus compute is unprecedented. Its strongest direction is to become a provider-neutral consumer compute control plane that treats the contributor device as sovereign, carries execution truth and device-care provenance, and refuses to manufacture authority from UI, provider registration, receipt text or telemetry gaps.
emergent_moat_after_internal_sweep.compressed_formula: ENTERTAINMENT_ENTRY + CONSENT + DEVICE_SOVEREIGNTY + PROVIDER_NEUTRALITY + TRUTH_CARRYING_COMPUTE + PROOF_OF_DEVICE_CARE + GAME_COMPUTE_SEPARATION
emergent_moat_after_internal_sweep.market_pitch_delta: Do not pitch only spare GPU supply. Pitch TRUSTED_SPARE_GPU_SUPPLY_WITH_USER_SOVEREIGNTY_AND_AUDITABLE_DEVICE_CARE.
